I am analyzing the current game state. I paid $14 rent to p1 on ST_JAMES_PLACE this turn, and my cash is $1,461.

I own only READING_RAILROAD. p1 has Vermont and St. James, p3 owns Electric Company, and p4 has Connecticut and Pennsylvania Railroad. Several properties remain unowned.

I am considering post-turn actions. Mortgaging Reading Railroad is not worthwhile since I have sufficient cash and would lose rent income. Trading for railroads seems difficult because I lack valuable assets to offer.

No player currently holds a full color set or monopoly. p4's Connecticut Railroad does not pair with any existing property. p1's Vermont and St. James are also incomplete. Purchasing Pennsylvania Railroad from p4 would likely be expensive.

I will end my turn. I have no color properties to complete a monopoly, and trading for another railroad would be too expensive.

I am reconsidering whether to propose a trade. I could offer Reading Railroad to p4 for Pennsylvania Railroad, but the engine would ask me again if the offer is rejected. I worry that making a bad trade would waste a turn or reveal my strategy.
